clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the year: your mother's worry over money from March 1988, her distance from your father on the subject by May 1988, your brother's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990; the shifts in these months beside the death are your mother's anxiety and distance, and your brother's drop in functioning, while your mother's later ease sits with the settling.
